God has spoken to us by his Son, the radiance of his glory. What does Jesus show you about God?
The Son is greater than the angels. Why does Hebrews stress how great Jesus is?
The heavens will wear out, but the Son remains the same. How does Christ's unchanging nature help you?
Hebrews warns us not to drift away. What causes you to drift?
We see Jesus, crowned with glory because he suffered death. What does this mean for you?
Jesus is not ashamed to call us brothers. How does this make you feel?
Because Jesus was tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted. Where do you need his help?
"Consider Jesus." What do you see when you consider him today?
"Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts." What is God saying to you today?
Exhort one another every day so no one is hardened by sin's deceit. Who could you encourage today?
Israel could not enter because of unbelief. How does unbelief show itself in your life?
There remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God. What does God's rest mean to you?
God's word is living and active, sharper than any sword. How has God's word cut to your heart?
We have a high priest who sympathises with our weaknesses. What can you bring to the throne of grace?
Christ did not exalt himself but was appointed by the Father. What does this teach about humility?
Jesus learned obedience through what he suffered. What does this show about suffering?
Hebrews speaks of moving from milk to solid food. How can you grow deeper in faith?
Hebrews urges us to go on to maturity. What would maturity look like for you?
God will not forget your work and love. How does this encourage you not to be sluggish?
Hope is an anchor for the soul, sure and steadfast. What holds you steady?
Melchizedek points to a greater priest. What makes Jesus' priesthood unique?
Jesus is the guarantor of a better covenant. Why is it better?
Jesus always lives to make intercession for us. What does it mean that Jesus is praying for you?
Jesus serves in the true tent set up by the Lord. Why does Hebrews call him a minister in the heavenly place?
God promises, "I will put my laws into their minds, and write them on their hearts." How has God written his ways on your heart?
The old covenant is becoming obsolete. What does the new covenant mean for you?
The earthly tabernacle could not perfect the worshipper's conscience. What does a cleansed conscience mean?
Christ's blood purifies our conscience to serve the living God. How do you serve him?
Without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness. Why was Christ's death necessary?
Christ appeared once for all to put away sin. What does "once for all" mean for you?
By God's will we have been sanctified through Christ's offering once for all. How does this give you confidence?
God says, "I will remember their sins no more." What does this mean for how you see your past?
Let us hold fast, stir one another up to love and good works, and keep meeting together. How can you stir someone up?
Hebrews reminds them of their past endurance. What has God helped you endure before?
Faith is the assurance of things hoped for. How would you describe faith in your own words?
These people died in faith, not having received the promises. What does it mean to live for a better country?
Which person in this "hall of faith" encourages you most, and why?
Some received great victories, others suffered greatly, yet all were commended for faith. What does this teach about faith?
Run with endurance, looking to Jesus. What weight do you need to lay aside?
God disciplines those he loves, for our good. How have you seen God shape you through hard things?
Strive for peace with everyone and for holiness. Where do you need to pursue peace?
We are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken. How does this help in a shaky world?
God says, "I will never leave you nor forsake you." How does this free you from the love of money?
"Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever." What comfort does this give?
Hebrews speaks of a sacrifice of praise and doing good. What can you offer God today?
The God of peace equips you with everything good to do his will. Where do you need his equipping?
